resources.string: Free and open source software under the GNU General Public License v3.0. No ads, no tracking.
A phone app for keypad phones like the Qin F21, Dumber Mini or Doov R77 Pro. Calling, call history, contacts and calls work with the D-pad and the keypad, no touchscreen needed.
Switch the tabs: call history, contacts, favorites
History: call back · Contacts: open the contact
Actions: send SMS, favorites, edit, block, delete…
Call the selected number or contact (nothing selected: dialing)
Send an SMS to the selected number or contact
On the first row: the top bar (jump to letter, search, dialpad, menu)
New contact, sort, clear the call history, settings, about
Jump to the first row; Back again leaves the app
Type the number, matching contacts are listed below
Call the number (or the selected contact)
Pick one of the matching contacts
Delete the last digit; with nothing typed: close
Add to contacts, send SMS, pause, wait
First press: silence the ringing · second press: hide the screen, the call keeps ringing silently
Pick a button: speaker, mute, hold, add call, hang up
Tones for menus of automated lines
Hang up (with the screen on and Android\'s \"Power button ends call\")
Silenced · Back again hides the screen
Silence the ringing (Android does this with the red / power key)
Turns the screen off during a call (3 seconds after it starts, and with the green key), so the ear can\'t touch anything; this phone has no proximity sensor. The app uses no other admin rights.
Turn the screen off during calls

This phone has no proximity sensor, so during a call the screen stays on at the ear and the ear can pull down the status bar. Allow the app to turn the screen off during calls (3 seconds after the call starts, and with the green key)? Android asks for \"device admin\" rights for this, only to lock the screen.
Turn the screen off (it also goes off 3 s after the call starts); green or Back turns it on
